steps.title: Finish the game’s setup
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose your own supported Glover USA ROM in the upstream launcher. Its reviewed Glover source adaptation keeps this game distinct from Rocket-R and verifies its own ROM identity. Configure controls and compatible mods through upstream menus; the published player requires no game compilation.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose your own supported Glover USA ROM in the upstream launcher. Its reviewed Glover source adaptation keeps this game distinct from Rocket-R and verifies its own ROM identity. Configure controls and compatible mods through upstream menus; the published player requires no game compilation. Default settings, saves, mod profiles and mod-specific saves, logs and crash reports live in AppData/Glover-R, outside Portcove backups. The reviewed glover-r-data current-folder fallback is declared if present. Bundled engine/mod resources remain version-owned. Use an external registration for custom --config or developer overrides. Existing external copies keep their files and runtime owner. Gameplay, platform minimums and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations.
